crossRefs.note: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

translations.web: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
translations.bsb: five for those on the other side, and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle, to the west.
translations.kjv: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward.
translations.asv: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.
